synthetic_environment.scope: Public cued binary MI decoder drives an independently counterbalanced synthetic in-memory object selection. Gold labels are oracle-only; routing uses decoded class. Four mappings per EEG record do not create four independent EEG samples.

scope: Public cue-conditioned motor imagery decoding and bounded synthetic in-memory target selection; separate from spontaneous intention and real OS task completion.
limitations: Confidence threshold 0.8 is fixed; restricted binary softmax is not a calibrated intention probability.
Subject-cluster intervals condition on these trained checkpoints; no retraining uncertainty or multiplicity adjustment.
Fused encoder receives extra supervised updates after the scratch selected encoder; differences do not isolate the frozen LLM alone.
Final exploratory QC of 500 microvolt was selected using training signals only; cue, ocular, muscle and residual artifacts are not separated.
T0 is instructed rest in MI recordings; it is not natural continuous idle.
Four mapping episodes per EEG record do not create four independent EEG observations.
